narrative.intro: Mission Support and Test Services recorded $953M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Mission Support and Test Services won 4 awards so far, with an average award size of $238M. Obligations fell 4.2% year over year. The Department of Energy is the dominant buyer, obligating $953M, and Facilities Support Services is the dominant NAICS market, accounting for $953M. The General Services Administration appears as a much smaller buyer, obligating $61.2K, and General Automotive Repair is a much smaller market at $61.2K. Historical context shows obligations of $855M in FY21, $923M in FY22, $838M in FY23, $1.1B in FY24, and $995M in FY25. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date); the FY2026 totals here reflect obligations to date rather than full-year totals. That makes FY2026 an active year concentrated in a single large buyer and a single large NAICS market, while a secondary buyer and market register only modest activity measured in thousands of dollars.
